title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 123
paragraphs: He thus brought his life to an end; and Artaphrenes, governor of the province of Sardis, was appointed together with Otanes, the third of the commanders, to make an expedition against Ionia and the adjoining part of Aeolis. Of Ionia they captured the city of Clazomenae, and of the Aeolians Cyme.
